name: glasstarn
description: Ask how your work really flows. glasstarn reads your process history on your own computer and your agent explains the evidence.

interface.shortDescription: See how your work really flows.
interface.longDescription: Create or reopen an investigation, inventory company-approved extracts, propose and validate a reviewable preparation recipe, run deterministic glasstarn analysis, and answer follow-up questions from saved evidence.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this event log in a new local project.
Investigate why this ERP process is slow using these approved extracts.
Reopen my process-mining project and rerun it.
Inspect this OCEL extract and explain its scope.
